entry.summary:
[G] After the Rangitīkei winter, Meretini Bennett-Huxtable prepares her soil & garden beds for the planting season. She is guided by the teachings of her pāpā before her, and the Maramataka (Māori lunar calendar).

WATCH Once Were Gardeners @ https://www.rnz.co.nz/video
or on YouTube here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL3lS2qVBadNM-9oDfSYYI3dqfIc6GHIAG
